as_told.title: Sheehan traces symbols from crashed UFO photos in Blue Book files

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that in the late 1970s, at the request of President Jimmy Carter's administration, he was let into a secure room in Washington to look at the files of Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. There, he says, he saw clear photos of a crashed UFO, with strange symbols around the base of its dome, which he traced. Sheehan tells it firsthand and Michels often repeats it, but the details shift: the room is a basement room in the Madison building, the craft is on a mountaintop, in a snowy field or stuck in an embankment, and one telling puts it as early as 1974.
